witnesses.separates: The shape is drawn in 5, not 8. The concept finds no half that holds only 8 and background, and is undefined. The one-color and fewer-colors readings take the 5 half as the shape and stamp it in each pattern color.
The 8 shape fills only the top-left 2x2 of its 3x3 half. The concept stamps the whole 3x3 half, giving 9x9. The bounding-box reading stamps the 2x2 box of the shape, giving 6x6.

The input is 3x8, so its halves are 3x4 and not squares. The square reading finds no squares that divide the input and is undefined. The equal-halves reading cuts it into two 3x4 halves and stamps the 3x4 shape at each pattern cell, giving 9x16.

The shape is drawn in two colors, 5 and 6, and the pattern holds four. The one-color reading finds no half of one color and is undefined, and so is the concept, which finds no 8. The fewer-colors reading takes the two-color half as the shape and stamps its cells in each pattern color.

The pattern is drawn in one color, 2. The concept takes the half of 8 as the shape and stamps it in 2. Both halves are of one color, so the one-color reading is undefined, and both hold one color, so the fewer-colors reading is undefined too.

The pattern half is empty and the shape, drawn in 5, fills only a 2x2 box of its half. The one-color reading with the bounding box takes the 5 half as the shape and gives a 6x6 grid of background. The fewer-colors reading takes the empty half as the shape: copied as its whole half, the shape stamps nothing and gives a 9x9 grid of background, and the shape has no bounding box, so with the bounding box the reading is undefined. The concept finds no 8 and is undefined.
